name: @kojo/plugin-ui-sugar-lift
description: Sugar-lift panel (ui.panel contribution): scan a .kojo source, list the round-trip-verified lift candidates, preview a line-level diff of the selected subset and apply it. The write chain (encoding guard, backup, kernel-io behind both gates, read-back verification, file.changed event) lives in the kojo-sugar plugin's sugar.liftApply service - this plugin is presentation + intent only.
